#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

class Reader {
 private:
  static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 16;
  FILE* din;
  unsigned char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
  int bufferPointer, bytesRead;

 public:
  Reader() {
    din = stdin;
    bytesRead = bufferPointer = 0;
  }

  Reader(const string& filename) {
    din = fopen(filename.c_str(), "r");
    bytesRead = bufferPointer = 0;
  }

  ~Reader() {
    if (din != stdin && din != nullptr) {
      fclose(din);
    }
  }

 private:
  unsigned char read() {
    if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) {
      fillBuffer();
    }
    return buffer[bufferPointer++];
  }

  void fillBuffer() {
    bytesRead = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, din);
    if (bytesRead == 0) {
      buffer[0] = -1;
    }
    bufferPointer = 0;
  }

  bool isWhiteSpace(unsigned char n) {
    return (n == ' ' || n == '\n' || n == '\r' || n == '\t');
  }

 public:
  string nextLine() {
    string result = "";
    unsigned char c;
    while (isWhiteSpace(c = read()) && c != -1) {}
    while (c != -1) {
      if (c == '\n') {
        break;
      }
      result += (char)c;
      c = read();
    }
    return result;
  }

  int nextLineInt() {
    int cnt = 0;
    unsigned char c;
    while (isWhiteSpace(c = read()) && c != -1) {}
    for (int i = 0; i < 1; i++) {
      if (c == '0') {
        cnt++;
      }
      c = read();
    }
    return cnt;
  }

  string next() {
    string result = "";
    unsigned char c;
    while (isWhiteSpace(c = read()) && c != -1) {}
    while (c != -1) {
      if (isWhiteSpace(c)) {
        break;
      }
      result += (char)c;
      c = read();
    }
    return result;
  }

  string next(int size) {
    string result = "";
    unsigned char c;
    while (isWhiteSpace(c = read()) && c != -1) {}
    while (c != -1 && result.length() < size) {
      if (isWhiteSpace(c)) {
        break;
      }
      result += (char)c;
      c = read();
    }
    return result;
  }

  char nextChar() {
    unsigned char c = read();
    while (isWhiteSpace(c) && c != -1)
      c = read();
    return (char)c;
  }

  int nextInt() {
    int ret = 0;
    unsigned char c = read();
    while (isWhiteSpace(c) && c != -1)
      c = read();
    bool neg = (c == '-');
    if (neg)
      c = read();
    if (!(c >= '0' && c <= '9')) {
      // Handle error case
      return 0;
    }
    do {
      ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
    } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9' && c != -1);
    if (neg)
      return -ret;
    return ret;
  }

  long long nextLong() {
    long long ret = 0;
    unsigned char c = read();
    while (isWhiteSpace(c) && c != -1)
      c = read();
    bool neg = (c == '-');
    if (neg)
      c = read();
    if (!(c >= '0' && c <= '9')) {
      // Handle error case
      return 0;
    }
    do {
      ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
    } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9' && c != -1);
    if (neg)
      return -ret;
    return ret;
  }

  double nextDouble() {
    double ret = 0, div = 1;
    unsigned char c = read();
    while (isWhiteSpace(c) && c != -1)
      c = read();
    bool neg = (c == '-');
    if (neg)
      c = read();
    do {
      ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
    } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9' && c != -1);

    if (c == '.') {
      while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9' && c != -1) {
        ret += (c - '0') / (div *= 10);
      }
    }

    if (neg)
      return -ret;
    return ret;
  }
};

long long largest_power(long long N) {
  N = N | (N >> 1);
  N = N | (N >> 2);
  N = N | (N >> 4);
  N = N | (N >> 8);
  N = N | (N >> 16);
  N = N | (N >> 32);
  return (N + 1) >> 1;
}

int main() {
  Reader in;
  ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(nullptr);

  int n = in.nextInt();
  string z = in.next();
  int k = 0, count = 0;
  vector<int> ans(2, 0);

  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (z[i] == '_') {
      if (count > ans[k] && k == 0)
        ans[k] = count;
      else if (k == 1) {
        if (count > 0)
          ans[k]++;
      }
      count = 0;
    } else if (z[i] == '(') {
      k = 1;
      if (count > ans[0])
        ans[0] = count;
      count = 0;
    } else if (z[i] == ')') {
      k = 0;
      if (count > 0)
        ans[1]++;
      count = 0;
    } else {
      count++;
    }
  }
  if (count > ans[0] && k == 0)
    ans[0] = count;

  cout << ans[0] << " " << ans[1] << "\n";

  return 0;
}
